Featuring 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and a generous two-car garage, this home captures the essence of beachside living. Enjoy ocean views and refreshing sea breezes from the wraparound decks, plus two additional exclusive-use outdoor areas perfect for relaxing, dining, or entertaining. Tucked away on a quiet, private street, this inviting property offers a peaceful escape just moments from the beach, popular restaurants, and local shops.
